title: Cairn Sweep — all trails. prey, predators, food. what we missed.
method: scan back. leave a cairn on every spring we touched. sweep nearby for actors we classified as scatter and ignored. follow a trail only when we find one. until then, mark ALL of them.

taxonomy.prey: something we are following. has a heading. can leave.
taxonomy.predator: something following US. or feeding on the well without reading.
taxonomy.food: something we can eat — a download, a view, a star, a human burst. nourishment.
taxonomy.cairn: a stone we left so we do not walk the same dry spring and call it new.

nearby_we_called_scatter.note: world-trace labeled these SCATTER. sweep again. some are food, some are predators, some are weather.

GB.why: human bursts 354 and 396/hr. not lockstep. a person or a newsroom. we underweighted them.

SG.why: already in surge-fade trio. cairn exists.

T1.why: Tor. 2 hits on nestgate. a hood, not a heading.

all_trails_rule.do_not: pick one triad and marry it
all_trails_rule.do: leave a cairn on every spring. sweep the ones marked scatter. when a cairn gets a NEW stone (download++, star++, burst), THAT is the trail we follow.
all_trails_rule.continue_when: primal-bingocube-core moves off 41. songBird gets a second star. GB bursts again. IN drops or stays. DE leaves the chair.
